Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ هَدَانَا لِحَمْدِهِ
Translation: All praise belongs to Allah who has guided us to His praise

Arabic text: وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ لِنَكُونَ لِإِحْسَانِهِ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
Translation: And made us among its people so that we may be grateful for His favors

Arabic text: وَلِيَجْزِيَنَا عَلَى ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
Translation: And that He may reward us for that with the reward of the good-doers

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ حَبَانَا بِدِينِهِ
Translation: And praise be to Allah who has honored us with His religion

Arabic text: وَاخْتَصَّنَا بِمِلَّتِهِ وَسَبَّلَنَا فِيْ سُبُلِ إِحْسَانِهِ
Translation: And distinguished us with His path and directed us to the ways of His kindness

Arabic text: لِنَسْلُكَهَا بِمَنِّهِ إِلَى رِضْوَانِهِ
Translation: So that we may traverse them by His favor to His pleasure

Arabic text: حَمْدًا يَتَقَبَّلُهُ مِنَّا وَيَرْضَى بِهِ عَنَّا
Translation: A praise that He accepts from us and is pleased with us through it

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ السُّبُلِ شَهْرَهُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ
Translation: And praise be to Allah who has made one of those ways His month, the month of Ramadan

Arabic text: شَهْرَ الصِّيَامِ وَشَهْرَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَشَهْرَ الطَّهُورِ
Translation: The month of fasting, the month of Islam, the month of purity

Arabic text: وَشَهْرَ التَّمْحِيصِ وَشَهْرَ الْقِيَامِ
Translation: The month of purification, and the month of standing in prayer

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ
Translation: The month in which the Quran was sent down as guidance for people

Arabic text: وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْهُدَى وَالْفُرْقَانِ
Translation: And as clear proofs of guidance and the criterion

Arabic text: فَأَبَانَ فَضِيلَتَهُ عَلَى سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ
Translation: And He has made clear its excellence over all other months

Arabic text: بِمَا جَعَلَ لَهُ مِنَ الْحُرُمَاتِ الْمَوْفُورَةِ وَالْفَضَائِلِ الْمَشْهُورَةِ
Translation: By the abundant sanctities and well-known virtues He has placed in it

Arabic text: فَحَرَّمَ فِيهِ مَا أَحَلَّ فِيْ غَيْرِهِ إِعْظَامًا
Translation: He has prohibited in it what He has allowed in others as a glorification

Arabic text: وَحَجَرَ فِيهِ الْمَطَاعِمَ وَالْمَشَارِبَ إِكْرَامًا
Translation: And has forbidden in it food and drink as an honor

Arabic text: وَجَعَلَ لَهُ وَقْتًا بَيِّنًا لَا يُجِيزُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ أَنْ يُقَدَّمَ قَبْلَهُ
Translation: And He has appointed for it a clear time; the Mighty and Majestic does not permit it to be brought forward

Arabic text: وَلَا يَقْبَلُ أَنْ يُؤَخَّرَ عَنْهُ
Translation: Nor does He accept that it be delayed from its time

Arabic text: ثُمَّ فَضَّلَ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ لَيَالِيهِ عَلَى لَيَالِيْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
Translation: Then He has given preference to one night out of its nights over the nights of a thousand months

Arabic text: وَسَمَّاهَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ
Translation: And named it the Night of Power

Arabic text: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
Translation: The angels and the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord with every decree

Arabic text: سَلَامٌ دَائِمُ الْبَرَكَةِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ
Translation: Peace, constant in blessings until the rising of dawn

Arabic text: عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ بِمَا أَحْكَمَ مِنْ قَضَائِهِ
Translation: Upon whomever He wills of His servants according to His decisive decree

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَعْرِفَةَ فَضْلِهِ وَإِجْلَالَ حُرْمَتِهِ
Translation: And inspire us to recognize its excellence and to honor its sanctity

Arabic text: وَالتَّحَفُّظَ مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ فِيهِ
Translation: And to guard against what You have forbidden in it

Arabic text: وَأَعِنَّا عَلَى صِيَامِهِ بِكَفِّ الْجَوَارِحِ عَنْ مَعَاصِيكَ
Translation: And help us to fast in it by restraining our limbs from disobeying You

Arabic text: وَاسْتِعْمَالِهَا فِيهِ بِمَا يُرْضِيكَ
Translation: And employing them in that which pleases You

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا نُصْغِيَ بِأَسْمَاعِنَا إِلَى لَغْوٍ
Translation: So that we do not listen with our ears to idle talk

Arabic text: وَلَا نُسْرِعَ بِأَبْصَارِنَا إِلَى لَهْوٍ
Translation: Nor hasten with our eyes to places of diversion

Arabic text: وَحَتَّى لَا نَبْسُطَ أَيْدِيَنَا إِلَى مَحْظُورٍ
Translation: And that we do not stretch out our hands toward the forbidden

Arabic text: وَلَا نَخْطُوَ بِأَقْدَامِنَا إِلَى مَحْجُورٍ
Translation: Nor take steps with our feet toward the prohibited

Arabic text: وَحَتَّى لَا تَعِيَ بُطُونُنَا إِلَّا مَا أَحْلَلْتَ
Translation: And that our stomachs not contain except what You have made lawful

Arabic text: وَلَا تَنْطِقَ أَلْسِنَتُنَا إِلَّا بِمَا مَثَّلْتَ
Translation: And our tongues not speak except what You have exemplified

Arabic text: وَلَا نَتَكَلَّفَ إِلَّا مَا يُدْنِيْ مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ
Translation: And that we do not undertake except that which brings us near to Your reward

Arabic text: وَلَا نَتَعَاطَى إِلَّا الَّذِيْ يَقِيْ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ
Translation: And that we do not pursue except that which protects from Your punishment

Arabic text: ثُمَّ خَلِّصْ ذٰلِكَ كُلَّهُ مِنْ رِئَاءِ الْمُرَائِينَ وَسُمْعَةِ الْمُسْمِعِينَ
Translation: Then purify all of that from the showing off of those who show off and the seeking of reputation

Arabic text: لَا نَشْرِكُ فِيهِ أَحَدًا دُونَكَ
Translation: So that we do not associate anyone with You in it

Arabic text: وَلَا نَبْتَغِيْ فِيهِ مُرَادًا سِوَاكَ
Translation: And we do not seek in it any object other than You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَقِفْنَا فِيهِ عَلَى مَوَاقِيتِ
Translation: And make us observe in it the times

Arabic text: اَلصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ بِحُدُودِهَا الَّتِيْ حَدَّدْتَ
Translation: Of the five prayers with the limits You have set

Arabic text: وَفُرُوضِهَا الَّتِيْ فَرَضْتَ وَوَظَائِفِهَا الَّتِيْ وَظَّفْتَ
Translation: And the obligations You have decreed and the duties You have assigned

Arabic text: وَأَوْقَاتِهَا الَّتِيْ وَقَّتَّ
Translation: And the times You have specified

Arabic text: وَأَنْزِلْنَا فِيهَا مَنْزِلَةَ الْمُصِيبِينَ لِمَنَازِلِهَا
Translation: And place us in it in the position of those who attain their stations

Arabic text: اَلْحَافِظِينَ لِأَرْكَانِهَا الْمُؤَدِّينَ لَهَا
Translation: Those who observe their pillars and perform them

Arabic text: فِيْ أَوْقَاتِهَا عَلَى مَا سَنَّهُ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: In their proper times according to what Your servant and messenger (Your blessings be upon him and his family) has established

Arabic text: فِيْ رُكُوعِهَا وَسُجُودِهَا وَجَمِيْعِ فَوَاضِلِهَا
Translation: In their bowing, prostration, and all their excellences

Arabic text: عَلَى أَتَمِّ الطَّهُورِ وَأَسْبَغِهِ وَأَبْيَنِ الْخُشُوعِ وَأَبْلَغِهِ
Translation: With the most complete and ample purification and the most evident and complete humility

Arabic text: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لِأَنْ نَصِلَ أَرْحَامَنَا بِالْبِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ
Translation: And help us in it to be kind and maintain relations with our relatives

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نَتَعَاهَدَ جِيرَانَنَا بِالْإِفْضَالِ وَالْعَطِيَّةِ
Translation: And to attend to our neighbors with benefaction and giving

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نُخَلِّصَ أَمْوَالَنَا مِنَ التَّبِعَاتِ
Translation: And to free our possessions from claims

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نُطَهِّرَهَا بِإِخْرَاجِ الزَّكَوَاتِ
Translation: And purify them by giving out zakat

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نُرَاجِعَ مَنْ هَاجَرَنَا
Translation: And that we may return to those who have abandoned us

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نُنْصِفَ مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا
Translation: And be just to those who have wronged us

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نُسَالِمَ مَنْ عَادَانَا
Translation: And make peace with those who show enmity toward us

Arabic text: حَاشَى مَنْ عُودِيَ فِيكَ وَلَكَ
Translation: Except for those who are hostile for Your sake and on Your account

Arabic text: فَإِنَّهُ الْعَدُوُّ الَّذِيْ لَا نُوَالِيهِ
Translation: For that is the enemy whom we shall not befriend

Arabic text: وَالْحِزْبُ الَّذِيْ لَا نُصَافِيهِ
Translation: And the party whom we shall not hold dear

Arabic text: وَأَنْ نَتَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْكَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْأَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَةِ بِمَا تُطَهِّرُنَا بِهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ
Translation: And that we may seek nearness to You through pure deeds that will cleanse us from sins

Arabic text: وَتَعْصِمُنَا فِيهِ مِمَّا نَسْتَأْنِفُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ
Translation: And protect us from renewing faults

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يُورِدَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: So that none of Your angels will bring to You

Arabic text: إِلَّا دُوْنَ مَا نُوْرِدُ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الطَّاعَةِ لَكَ وَأَنْوَاعِ الْقُرْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Anything from us except our various acts of obedience to You and kinds of nearness to You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the right of this month

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيهِ
Translation: And by the right of those who worship You in it

Arabic text: مِنِ ابْتِدَائِهِ إِلَى وَقْتِ فَنَائِهِ
Translation: From its beginning to its end

Arabic text: مِنْ مَلَكٍ قَرَّبْتَهُ أَوْ نَبِيٍّ أَرْسَلْتَهُ
Translation: From among the angels You have brought near or the prophets You have sent

Arabic text: أَوْ عَبْدٍ صَالِحٍ اخْتَصَصْتَهُ
Translation: Or the righteous servants You have singled out

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَهِّلْنَا فِيهِ لِمَا وَعَدْتَ أَوْلِيَاءَكَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: And make us worthy in it of what You have promised Your friends of Your generosity

Arabic text: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا فِيهِ مَا أَوْجَبْتَ لِأَهْلِ الْمُبَالَغَةِ فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And make obligatory for us in it what You have made obligatory for those who strive diligently in obeying You

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِيْ نَظْمِ مَنِ اسْتَحَقَّ الرَّفِيعَ الْأَعْلَى بِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And place us among those who deserve the highest elevation through Your mercy

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَجَنِّبْنَا الْإِلْحَادَ فِيْ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَالتَّقْصِيرَ فِيْ تَمْجِيدِكَ
Translation: And turn us aside from deviation in Your oneness and falling short in glorifying You

Arabic text: وَالشَّكَّ فِيْ دِينِكَ وَالْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ وَالْإِغْفَالَ لِحُرْمَتِكَ
Translation: And doubt about Your religion and blindness toward Your path and neglect of Your sanctity

Arabic text: وَالْإِنْخِدَاعَ لِعَدُوِّكَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
Translation: And being deceived by Your enemy, the accursed Satan

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَإِذَا كَانَ لَكَ فِيْ كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ لَيَالِيْ شَهْرِنَا هَذَا
Translation: And if in each night of our month there are

Arabic text: رِقَابٌ يُعْتِقُهَا عَفْوُكَ أَوْ يَهَبُهَا صَفْحُكَ
Translation: Necks which Your pardon will release or Your forgiveness will grant

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ تِلْكَ الرِّقَابِ
Translation: Then place our necks among those necks

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِشَهْرِنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ أَهْلٍ وَأَصْحَابٍ
Translation: And make us for our month among the best of people and companions

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَامْحَقْ ذُنُوبَنَا مَعَ امِّحَاقِ هِلَالِهِ
Translation: And blot out our sins along with the disappearing of its crescent

Arabic text: وَاسْلَخْ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا مَعَ انْسِلَاخِ أَيَّامِهِ
Translation: And remove our offenses along with the passing of its days

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَنْقَضِيَ عَنَّا وَقَدْ صَفَّيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
Translation: Until it departs from us and You have cleansed us in it from our errors

Arabic text: وَأَخْلَصْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
Translation: And purified us in it from our evil deeds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَإِنْ مِلْنَا فِيهِ فَعَدِّلْنَا وَإِنْ زُغْنَا فِيهِ فَقَوِّمْنَا
Translation: And if we deviate in it, then set us right; if we go astray in it, then correct us

Arabic text: وَإِنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَدُوُّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنَا مِنْهُ
Translation: And if Your enemy Satan encompasses us, then deliver us from him

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اشْحَنْهُ بِعِبَادَتِنَا إِيَّاكَ
Translation: O Allah, fill it with our worship of You

Arabic text: وَزَيِّنْ أَوْقَاتَهُ بِطَاعَتِنَا لَكَ
Translation: And adorn its times with our obedience to You

Arabic text: وَأَعِنَّا فِيْ نَهَارِهِ عَلَى صِيَامِهِ
Translation: And help us during its daylight to fast

Arabic text: وَفِيْ لَيْلِهِ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ
Translation: And during its night to pray

Arabic text: وَالتَّضَرُّعِ إِلَيْكَ وَالْخُشُوعِ لَكَ
Translation: And to implore You and to humble ourselves before You

Arabic text: وَالذِّلَّةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: And to be lowly before You

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يَشْهَدَ نَهَارُهُ عَلَيْنَا بِغَفْلَةٍ وَلَا لَيْلُهُ بِتَفْرِيطٍ
Translation: So that its day may not bear witness against us of heedlessness nor its night of neglect

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِيْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ وَالْأَيَّامِ كَذَلِكَ مَا عَمَّرْتَنَا
Translation: O Allah, make us thus in all the months and days as long as You give us life

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: And place us among Your righteous servants

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
Translation: Those who shall inherit Paradise, wherein they shall dwell forever

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا آتُوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ
Translation: And those who give what they give while their hearts

Arabic text: وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
Translation: Are fearful that they are returning to their Lord

Arabic text: وَمِنَ الَّذِيْنَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِيْ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
Translation: And among those who race to good deeds and they are foremost in them

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَكُلِّ أَوَانٍ وَعَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
Translation: In every time, in every moment, and in every state

Arabic text: عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: To the number of what You have blessed upon those whom You have blessed

Arabic text: وَأَضْعَافَ ذٰلِكَ كُلِّهِ بِالْأَضْعَافِ
Translation: And multiply all that with manifold increases

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ لَا يُحْصِيهَا غَيْرُكَ
Translation: That none can count except You

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا تُرِيدُ
Translation: Surely You do whatever You will
